title: Compute Budget Guardian
subtitle: Holds the line on the daily spend that only you set: it refuses any start the budget cannot cover and says why, warns you as spend climbs, and stops paid machines at the cap.
lede: Holds the line on the daily spend that only you set: it refuses any start the budget cannot cover and says why, warns you as spend climbs, and stops paid machines at the cap. No agent can raise the number; only you can, at your own terminal.
who: A founder or finance lead who signs off on compute spend
author: Corey James
